articles.summary: In today’s volatile market, real estate asset owners face the dual challenge of rising construction costs and high interest rates, both of which impact profitability and long-term value. For owners managing capital-intensive projects, controlling expenses without sacrificing quality is more critical than ever. This article explores practical cost management strategies specifically for real estate owners who seek to balance financial pressures with the demand for durable, high-value assets. By adopting innovative approaches to material procurement, workforce efficiency, and project scheduling, real estate asset owners can better control costs on the margins and protect their investments.
articles.title: Cost Management Strategies for Real Estate Owners: Navigating Rising Construction Expenses and Interest Rates

articles.summary: For years, real estate asset owners relied on spreadsheets as the backbone of portfolio management. Spreadsheets provided a flexible solution to track expenses, plan capital expenditures (CapEx), and project long-term performance. But as portfolios grow, so does the complexity of managing them. Increasingly, spreadsheets reveal their limitations, from tracking issues to data entry errors that could compromise asset performance and reduce returns.
articles.title: From Spreadsheets to Success: Transforming Real Estate Portfolio Management
